customization.philosophyQuote: An engraving isn't just marks burnt into surface; it's the transfer of a family signature across generations.

sections.title: Turn Moments Into Memories
sections.subtitle: Where Your Ideas Become Keepsakes
sections.description: The best gifts are the ones that tell a story. At Nicoletta, we create personalized keepsakes and custom designs made around your ideas, your memories, and the people you love. From engraved pieces to unique handmade creations, every item is crafted with love to make your special moments unforgettable.

sections.title: Our Featured Pieces

sections.title: The Nicoletta Difference
sections.subtitle: Handmade with Love
sections.step1Title: Made With Care, Made For You
sections.step1Desc: We create personalized gifts and custom pieces for the moments you want to remember. Whether it’s a birthday, wedding, anniversary, new home, or just a little something for someone special, we help turn your ideas into meaningful keepsakes.
sections.step2Desc: A name, a date, a special message, or a unique design can turn an everyday item into something unforgettable. We create custom pieces with your story in mind, using engraving and personalized details on wood, glass, acrylic, leather, and more.
sections.step3Title: Have Something In Mind? Let’s Create It
sections.step3Desc: Whether you know exactly what you want or need a little inspiration, we’re here to help bring your idea to life. Every piece is made with care and created to make someone smile.

sections.title: What's New at Nicoletta
sections.subtitle: Latest News, Markets & Offers
sections.description: Stay up to date with our latest news, upcoming local craft fairs, pop-up events, and limited-time offers.

sections.title: Reviews
sections.subtitle: Real Stories From Our Customers
sections.description: Hear from the people who trusted us to create something meaningful for their special moments.

sections.title: Nicoletta Decor
sections.subtitle: Meet the Crafter
sections.description: Founded in Portland, Oregon in 2021 by artisan Nicoletta, our shop was born out of a deep reverence for organic materials and classic design. We select local, sustainably-cut timber and cure each board by hand.
sections.extraText1: Every laser brand and sandblast carving is executed one-by-one with surgical attention to grain and texture. We never treat your project as generic manufacture; we create future heirlooms destined to outlast us all.

sections.title: Let’s Create Something Unique
sections.description: Have an idea you don’t see anywhere else? We love creating personalized gifts, event pieces, and custom orders tailored to your ideas. Let’s bring your vision to life.

sections.title: Our Collections
sections.description: Filter our signature collection categories. Select an item to submit your specific engraving guidelines.

sections.title: Submit Your Custom Request
sections.subtitle: Personalize Your Item
sections.description: Every personalized item starts with your vision. Share your names, messages, colors, images, logos, or design ideas, and we'll prepare a custom design for your approval before we begin crafting your order.

sections.title: Stories from our Costumers
sections.subtitle: Reviews & Experience
sections.description: Verified reviews left by our amazing customers. Submit your own review below.

sections.title: Connect with Us
sections.subtitle: Can't find exactly what you're looking for?
sections.description: We'd love to help! Send us your idea, inspiration, or a custom request, and we'll let you know if we can create it. If it's possible, we'll work with you to design a personalized piece that's exactly what you had in mind.
sections.extraText2: Located near Village Mall. Full location shared once your order is confirmed.
